column1: Trips input fields accept invalid special characters and fail to display input validation errors
column26:
_Bug Summary:_
The location input fields under the "Trips" panel accept completely invalid strings containing only punctuation and special characters without triggering any user input validation errors or clearing out the entry fields.

_Steps to Reproduce:_

# Open a desktop web browser and navigate to the Live Traffic NSW site ([http://livetraffic.com|http://livetraffic.com|smart-link] ).
# Click the "Trips" navigation tab on the left-hand panel menu.
# In the first location text entry field, type the special character string: / , . . . .
# In the second destination text entry field, type the special character string: , / /
# Observe how the application handles the input.

_Expected Result:_
The application should validate the address input strings. It should show a clear validation error message (e.g., "Please enter a valid address or location") and block the user from trying to search with raw special characters.

_Actual Result:_
The application accepts the strings completely, leaving the raw characters permanently visible inside the fields with no validation alerts displayed to help the user.
